decisions.about: Where the steps of a typed command lie
decisions.decided: each command the person types has its SKILL.md hold the steps of that moment, as Claude Code loads it when typed, and the main conversation's part holds only the steps that every moment shares; where the plugin's work runs over many turns, the main conversation decides nothing and a subagent started at each event decides, so no context carries the run

decisions.about: Each step and each practice carried out
decisions.decided: each role's steps say each practice and file it takes, and Lane lays the rule that their words call for, as Lane's up does: a step done in order, a checklist from the plugin's adapter of a step's items, a file read whole or never read, a path written only; the plugin's own check runs at each end only for what no rule of Lane's holds, such as a result against its cut
a prompt is a part: unit tests run it on the model its users run, several times, and E2E tests try it in real use

an evaluator answers each question good, with the lines that meet it, or what would make it good, in the plugin guide's words good, more, and good_when, and the plugin template, rn, and Lane use those words wherever they carry an evaluator's answer

decisions.about: Where a plugin writes its files, and the deliverables it makes
decisions.decided: the guide's rule of where a plugin writes covers the files of the plugin's own run; a deliverable that a run makes for the user lies where the repository's layout or the tool that reads it puts it, such as a best practice rn makes at .rn/best-practices/<kind>/, as the design tree best practice decides a deliverable's path

decisions.about: When the guard runs the record check on the main conversation
decisions.decided: the guard runs the plugin's own record check at a role's end and at each end of the main conversation's turn in a run, and the check passes a turn that puts no work up for the caller, such as one that asks a question

decisions.about: How a prompt's unit tests judge
decisions.decided: each case runs as many times as Test strategy sets, each run a test of its own, and the developer judges the prompt from the results, with no criterion, as a criterion over runs that vary passes or fails by chance
